name: Notice for August 20, 2024 City Council Meeting - Item 5A - Exhibit 1
agenda_text:
CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  NOTICE
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that materials related to an upcoming agenda item scheduled
for the August 20, 2024 City Council Regular Meeting have been provided in advance and
are now available to allow proper time for review before the meeting.

607 W. Roses Road
Planning Case No: GPA21-001, ZC21-001, ZTA21-001, and LTA21-009 (General Plan
Amendment, Zone Change, Zone Text Amendment, and Lot Line Adjustment)
Applicant: San Gabriel Cemetery

  •  Exhibit 1

Please note that some materials may be in draft form and are subject to revision.
Finalized documents will be posted with the agenda for the Regular Meeting.

For any questions related to this staff report, please contact the Community
Development Department at 626-308-2806.

Julie Nguyen, City Clerk
425 South Mission Drive
City of San Gabriel, California

Dated: August 2, 2024
